title: Collateral double-spend post liquidation is possible
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as a borrower can double-spend his collateral  **Likelihood:** High, as liquidations never subtract the collateral amount  ## Description  In `AssetManager::assetTransferOnLoanAction` in the `if (action == AssetActionType.Seize)` statement, the transferred amount is only subtracted from `userDepositFrom.lockedAmount`, but it should have also been subtracted from `userDepositFrom.depositAmount` as well.
